title: 第8章：丰收
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
时间悄然流逝。

    “爸，我出去挖野菜了，有啥事你就招呼强子，他和莉莉就在院子里玩。”

    马超收拾好镰刀，铁锹，背篓几样工具，就准备出门。

    床上传来马建业的笑骂声，“我又不是小娃娃，你自己在外也要多注意点安全。”

    “好的爸，我会小心的。”

    马超放心点了点头，又叮嘱好三个小家伙。

    其实说起来，挖野菜的地就在山脚下，离家门两里多的路，真要遇见啥事，不用二十分钟就能返回，也正因如此，马超才放心大胆让马娟一个十岁大的孩子到地里挖红薯叶。

    好在野菜这玩意极容易生长，只要土壤适宜地方，就能生根发芽。

    “大哥，你把水壶背着，渴的时候喝点水。”

    这时候，马娟将一个掉了漆的旧军用水壶塞到马超手里。

    别看军用水壶此时破破烂烂的，要放六七十年代，那可是队里独树一帜的稀罕物。

    “那你喝水咋办？”

    “我就在咱家地里挖红薯叶，近的很，渴了我自己回来喝水好了。”

    马超心里一暖，“行，哥知道了，咱们娟子现在成大姑娘，越来越会过日子了。”

    “大哥，说什么呢，再说我不理你了。”

    小丫头跺脚，此时她小脸红扑扑的，也不知道是羞的还是因为长大了。

    看到小丫头这副模样，马超乐了，“好好好，是大哥说错话了。”

    “好了，都回去吧！”

    ……

    告别弟弟妹妹们，马超正要赶往山脚下，远远就看见一个中年妇人牵着个孩子，朝自己这边走来。

    一看见此人，马超嘴角直抽，暗骂一声：“晦气！”

    这女人名叫江彩霞，生得一副尖酸刻薄的脸，再加上两家早先又因为宅基地的事，闹过矛盾，本就互看两厌。

    可自从马超父母离婚后，这一切都变了。

    要知道，80 年代还是一个相对保守的年代，况且还是离婚这种大事。

    即使村里人明面上不会说什么，可背地里大多是一副看笑话的心态。

    而江彩霞就是其中跳得最欢的一个，偏偏她每次还表现出一副说教的语气，简直让人恶心到了极点。

    “哟，这不是马家老大吗？”
content_en:
Time passed quietly.

    "Dad, I went out to dig wild vegetables. If you need anything, just call Qiangzi. He and Lily are playing in the yard."

    Ma Chao packed up his sickle, shovel, and backpack and prepared to go out.

    Ma Jianye's laughter and scolding came from the bed, "I'm not a little baby. You should pay more attention to your safety when you are outside."

    "Okay Dad, I'll be careful."

    Ma Chao nodded in relief and warned the three little guys again.

    In fact, speaking of it, the field for digging wild vegetables is at the foot of the mountain, more than two miles away from the house. If anything happens, you can return in less than twenty minutes. Because of this, Ma Chao felt confident and bold enough to let Ma Juan, a ten-year-old child, dig sweet potato leaves in the field.

    Fortunately, wild vegetables are very easy to grow. As long as the soil is suitable, they can take root and sprout.

    "Brother, carry the kettle on your back and drink some water when you are thirsty."

    At this time, Ma Juan thrust an old military kettle with paint off into Ma Chao's hand.

    Even though the military kettle is in tatters now, it must have been in the 1960s and 1970s. It was a unique and rare item in the team.

    "What should you do if you drink water?"

    "I'm digging sweet potato leaves in our field. It's very close. If I'm thirsty, I'll come back and drink water myself."

    Ma Chao felt warm in his heart, "Okay, I understand, brother, our Juanzi has become a big girl now and is getting better and better at living."

    "Brother, what are you talking about? I won't pay attention to you anymore."

    The little girl stamped her feet. Her face was flushed, and she didn't know whether it was because she was ashamed or because she had grown up.

    Seeing the little girl's appearance, Ma Chao was happy, "Okay, okay, brother said the wrong thing."

    "Okay, let's all go back!"

    …

    Saying goodbye to his brothers and sisters, Ma Chao was about to rush to the foot of the mountain when he saw a middle-aged woman holding a child walking toward him from a distance.

    As soon as he saw this person, Ma Chao's mouth twitched and he cursed secretly: "Bad luck!"

    This woman's name was Jiang Caixia, and she had a sharp and mean face. In addition, the two families had had conflicts over the homestead issue earlier, so they already disliked each other.

    But since Ma Chao's parents divorced, everything has changed.

    You know, the 1980s was still a relatively conservative era, and divorce was still a big deal.

    Even if the villagers don't say anything on the surface, most of them look at the joke behind their backs.

    Jiang Caixia was the one who danced the most happily, but she always had a preaching tone, which was extremely disgusting.

    "Hey, isn't this the boss of the Ma family?"
